review_blinding: Gold labels were represented only as L1/L2 cell codes during the content review; no model behavior existed or was inspected.

checks.evidence_self_contained_enough_for_evide: 32/32; page-local pronouns/editorial artifacts were retained and documented rather than semantically cherry-picked

pre_freeze_rule_revision.reason: The first blinded audit exposed explicit extraction debris and one obviously truncated terminal token. Before any sample was selected, a deterministic source-artifact rule was added and the audit candidate set regenerated once from the official test file.
pre_freeze_rule_revision.rule_scope: Encoding replacement/mojibake markers, query fragments, dangling terminal markup, unbalanced delimiters, and one/two-letter incomplete terminal tokens.

retained_limitations: Some canonical benchmark evidence uses pronouns, page-local context, awkward spacing, or editorial artifacts.
Those schema-valid cases were retained because removing them by semantic judgment would cherry-pick difficulty and change the benchmark population.
The task is evidence-relative benchmark classification, not independent verification of Wikipedia truth.
